design_reference: Use the same interaction concept common to ESPN/Yahoo fantasy player pages: compact status indicator near the player name, expandable current-status/news detail, and recent-game context. Do not copy proprietary visual design or text.

status_badge.placement: player profile header/corner near player name

rules: Keep the panel compact and decision-useful rather than a full medical history.
Expected return is shown only when supported by current evidence; otherwise show Unknown/TBD.
Suspension notes show covered games or return week/date when known.
Stale notes must not remain attached after a player clears the status.
Recent-game statistics are factual context and never directly alter the model twice if those stats already entered the rolling football state.
Current news may trigger a model refresh only through a canonical football-state field with authorized model authority.
News display and model authority are separate: a note can appear without receiving numeric projection weight.
No sportsbook information is allowed in this profile-news layer.

automation.status_updates: Hourly current-status poll plus normal weekly ingestion.
automation.recent_game_updates: After finalized game statistics enter the weekly outcome/stat pipeline.
automation.profile_refresh: The client reads the latest persisted canonical state with no manual per-player UI edits.
